  > 
  > Tab 3: tables/tab3.tex, a fragment of 6 lines at 8 pt (2 header lines, tool row, two replay rows, one verdict line), 0.8 in high, fits \linewidth with no overfull box. Columns: evaluated, reported, true, gap (95% interval), gap without own demos, predicted; n = 60 is in the first header cell. Rows: dspy tool (t over 24 draws): 19, 35.7, 29.1, 6.6 (3.9-9.3), 4.8 (2.1-7.5), 5.4. Replay B = 20 with the pool-bootstrap interval, marked * (the interval used for the verdict): 5.8 (5.2-6.5). Replay B = 20 with draw noise included (not used for the verdict): 5.8 (4.9-6.7). Last line: "*Used for the verdict: not consistent (tool gap 0.15 above the interval; 24 draws, tested)." Your caption should say that the tool's interval is a t interval over draws and the replay's is a pool-bootstrap interval, and that the tool's own interval contains the replay gap. All numbers are accuracy points (6.6 = 0.066); the script computes the leak-free interval from the draws file.
  > 
  > Tab 1 compute rows (appendix): matrix 193,536 (item, configuration) cells and 6.41 million tokens forwarded with caching (89.9 million as stand-alone prompts), from matrix_tokens.json; real tool 24 draws, 4,293 s each, 39,189 language-model calls, 103,039 s summed wall time, from real_tool_draws.parquet. I did not put the world-charged 311.7 CPU-hours or the matrix's 187,354 s in the table: they are in no result file, only in experiment-repo's README, and I do not type numbers by hand. State them in the text (checklist item 8), or if experiment-repo adds them to matrix_facts I add the row.
